signals.title: 云阙问剑 v7 / MakePlay Arcade
signals.summary: A browser- and mobile-playable bilingual xianxia action, platform, and RPG work shows personal cultural expression becoming a playable world rather than remaining text, image, or video.
signals.creator: Soran; MakePlay
signals.what_was_created: A directly playable and shareable xianxia game at version 7, built inside a natural-language creation and publishing workflow that combines characters, animation, rules, music, and levels.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI reduced coordination costs across visual assets, animation, game logic, music, level design, hosting, and distribution.
signals.human_behavior_change: A creator can turn a personal aesthetic or small-community reference into rules, space, failure conditions, and replayable interaction, then continue directing it through versions.
signals.transferable_idea: When AI compresses several specialist roles into one interface, preserve playtesting, revision, and ongoing direction instead of stopping at one-click generation.

signals.title: Gauth AI Course
signals.summary: Gauth combines cinematic narrative, concept maps, immediate questions, tutoring, and recall quizzes into courses that can be assembled around a topic and learner level.
signals.evidence_level: Real Product; learning outcomes are Vendor Claim
signals.creator: Gauth; Seedance 2.5 collaboration
signals.what_was_created: Accessible cinematic history courses and a path for learners to generate a micro-course from a topic and ability level.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI lowered the marginal production cost of scripts, narration, scenes, diagrams, questions, and level adaptation for multimodal courses.
signals.human_behavior_change: A learner can request a temporary course around a specific confusion instead of only searching within fixed chapters and prerecorded lessons.
signals.transferable_idea: Personalization can change explanatory narrative, examples, pacing, and interaction path, not only content difficulty.

signals.title: Meditation Timer Soundscapes
signals.summary: A creator generated, deployed, pinned, and reportedly uses a deliberately simple meditation timer every day after existing subscription products failed to match a narrow personal ritual.
signals.creator: Graham Barlow
signals.what_was_created: A deployed Web App with a calm visual design, ten-minute default, preparation time, breathing guidance, interval bells, themes, and environmental sound.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI reduced the translation cost between a precise personal need, interface design, implementation, and deployment.
signals.human_behavior_change: Failure to find the right low-risk app can now lead directly to making a personal tool instead of continuing to search or tolerating unwanted product complexity.
signals.transferable_idea: For bounded, low-risk personal needs, optimize for exact fit with one ritual rather than maximum market coverage.

signals.title: Koboyo Icons
signals.summary: An independent creator used AI to publish a searchable, semantically organized library of roughly 93,000 hand-drawn-style SVG icons covering common and long-tail concepts.
signals.creator: Kamran Ahmed
signals.what_was_created: A large free SVG icon library organized across people, actions, emotions, culture, science, system design, education, and everyday concepts.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI made it economically possible for one creator to cover a very long tail of visual concepts that a conventional design team would not prioritize.
signals.human_behavior_change: A creator can build a public visual-language database at a scale previously associated with teams, while users search within a coherent semantic system rather than collect isolated generated assets.
signals.transferable_idea: When generation cost approaches zero, value moves to classification, naming, retrieval, quality thresholds, consistency, licensing, and provenance.

signals.title: A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya / Bop
signals.summary: A small team treats software like a music label treats releases, while Bop turns listening into an interactive act of separating, remixing, and replaying human-made music.
signals.creator: Mauhan M. Zonoozy; A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya
signals.what_was_created: Bop, a Pocket DJ for separating vocals, drums, chords, and bass, changing tempo and pitch, and remixing through a pad interface, inside a broader catalog of small music applications.
signals.what_ai_changed: AI enabled a small team to develop and release experimental software continuously while remaining hidden from the consumer proposition; the music stems remain human-made.
signals.human_behavior_change: Listeners become temporary DJs who manipulate music, and software can be released, experienced, collected, and remembered like a song or small cultural work.
signals.transferable_idea: AI can remain production infrastructure; design the product around the new verb a person gains rather than around a visible AI feature.

patterns.title: Personal Software
patterns.summary: Software can exist for one person and one exact habit without needing a mass market, roadmap, or subscription business.
patterns.outlook: Likely to become a stable form for bounded, low-risk personal tools; formal software retains advantages in safety, payments, complex synchronization, and long-term maintenance.

patterns.title: Playable Self-expression
patterns.summary: Personal aesthetics, stories, opinions, and community references can become playable rule systems rather than static media.
patterns.outlook: May form a medium between games, social content, fan creation, personal gifts, and short-lived interactive works.
examples: 云阙问剑 v7 / MakePlay Arcade

patterns.title: Generated Curriculum
patterns.summary: A course can be assembled around a topic, current ability, and immediate confusion as a temporary learning object.
patterns.outlook: High potential, but durable value depends on factual reliability, cognitive design, difficulty control, and measured learning outcomes rather than cinematic quality.

patterns.title: Software as Cultural Release
patterns.summary: Small applications can be released like songs, publications, or artworks, with limited functions and a distinct creative identity rather than an obligation to become expanding SaaS products.
patterns.outlook: Could support software labels, interactive catalogs, limited releases, and creator identities organized by aesthetic rather than feature category.
examples: A Vinyl Bar in Shibuya / Bop

patterns.title: Generated Commons
patterns.summary: AI lets individuals build public resource libraries at database scale, including a long tail that conventional production economics would exclude.
patterns.outlook: The durable moat will come from information architecture, selection, consistency, licensing, accessibility, and trustworthy provenance rather than asset count.

ideas.title: Executable Field Notes
ideas.summary: Attach a three-to-five-minute interactive scenario to a research or engineering judgment: let a reader choose through a real trade-off, observe short-term benefits and long-term costs, change conditions, and then inspect the analysis and evidence.
